Its own header calls it 'THE MISSING PIECE IN THE DEPLOY CHAIN'. It checks out the repo, sets up Node 20, rejects a patcher path outside the repo, ALWAYS runs the patcher with --check first, then runs --apply only if mode=apply, then commits only if commit=yes.
CORRECTED_BLOCKER.why_i_cannot_use_it: It is MANUAL-ONLY BY DESIGN: 'on: workflow_dispatch' with no push trigger, and its own comment states 'nothing is written unless a human sets apply=apply'. Triggering it requires a POST to /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{id}/dispatches. No tool on this endpoint can do that - I hold github_repo_read, github_file_write, github_pr and github_create_branch only.

DEPLOY_LEVEL_ROOT_CAUSE_the_shadow.source: the same workflow's header, quoted verbatim
DEPLOY_LEVEL_ROOT_CAUSE_the_shadow.resolver_order: qnfo-fleet-deploy resolves a deploy payload as: 1. R2 qnfo-canonical/<worker>.js (only if fresh, <30 min); 2. GitHub raw, first 200 not starting with '404:': (a) qnfo-workers/main/<n>/deployed-current.worker.js, (b) qnfo-ops/main/cloud/<n>/deployed-current.worker.js, (c) qnfo-workers/main/<n>/worker.js <- the real source, (d) qnfo-ops/main/cloud/<n>/worker.js; 3. stale R2.
DEPLOY_LEVEL_ROOT_CAUSE_the_shadow.the_defect: Candidate (a) SHADOWS candidate (c). 'A stale mirror at (a) makes the comparator see deployed-ahead, so scan() skips the heal forever and no committed fix lands.'
DEPLOY_LEVEL_ROOT_CAUSE_the_shadow.why_this_matters: This is the deploy-level twin of the ticket-level auto-close defect. Ticket level: the drain closes a defect because the target is healthy. Deploy level: a committed fix never ships because a stale mirror makes the scanner believe the deployed build is ahead. Both make the system look converged while nothing converges.
DEPLOY_LEVEL_ROOT_CAUSE_the_shadow.status_for_qnfo-research-exec: the (a) mirror is now a '404:' tombstone (commit 45a8e360), so resolution falls through to (c) worker.js - but worker.js still carries the unpatched bundle, and the patcher needs a Node runner. The workflow IS that runner.
